test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the son of B’

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the father of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

If ‘C + M – S × K − P ÷ T’, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: K is the daughter of M.
C is the son of S.
K is the brother’s daughter of M.
K is the brother’s wife of T.

solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Son
 Wife
 Father
 Brother
 
 

 

Given: C + M – S × K − P ÷ T

It means C is son of M. M is wife of S. S is father of K. K is wife of P. P is brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf7193af112f05d7be2a13cf985db10e0e835b9d88e6c7213e0343abfca7b882.png] 

K is the daughter of M → True.

C is the son of S. → True.

K is the brother’s daughter of M. → False (Because, K is daughter of M).

K is the brother’s wife of T. → True.

Thus, K is the brother’s daughter of M is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
